comments.author: Maddog Matt
comments.body_html:
Known issue, but it is still not fixed. I thought I had already replied with this fix but i cannot see my post so I guess I did not. Got caught out a few times and died due to the gun being basically unusable in fights when on single fire.

Easy way to fix it yourself is to go to the mod folder Carl-QHB in your SPT install. Then open folder database and then templates. Open the file items.json in notepad.

On about line 218 you will see the text “bFirerate”: 775,

Above this add the line “SingleFireRate”: 450,

Should end up looking like this

“RecolDispersion”: 25,

“SingleFireRate”: 450,

“bFirerate”: 775,

Save and play. Now the gun actually has a single fire rate set and you can fire the gun properly in single fire mode.

The ST AR-15 mod has the same issue not having a single fire rate set so the game defaults to this slow fire rate when on single fire. Worse for that gun as it is single fire only. Do the same thing to fix that gun as well.

Just bear in mind I am using these mods on 3.5.8 and not 3.6.1 so everything may not be exactly the same for everyone.

comments.author: Brin
comments.body_html:
From what I can tell, that value got carried over from the original mod, and dates back to at least April of 2021 (which is before the major recoil increase from 12.12, the recoil reduction(s) around 13.5, and the recoil rework that came with 14).

Since that version (1.0.1) had completely separate “cherry bomb” variants for 5.56, 7.62x51, and .300 blk, and the first two had “normal” recoil values (-4 instead of -16), my bet is that the original author tuned the rest of the parts so that they were reasonably in line with other similar AR parts at the time, and then tuned a .300 BLK specific version of the muzzle device so that this gun would still be fun/usable.
